name: Flame Busters
review:
Flame Busters is a 243-ways slot about firefighters saving tenants from a burning building. It has wilds, fire symbols, a Fire Drill feature and free spins.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 5,280x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

The Fire Drill can liven up ordinary spins, while the free spins hold most of the upside. The cartoon rescue story gives the game more personality than its simple 243-ways layout suggests.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
